quote: We present Synchronous LLMs, a novel posttraining framework that converts an auto-regressive LLM into a full-duplex spoken dialogue agent.

...We propose a three-stage training recipe that leverages synthetic spoken dialogue generated from text dialogue data... We evaluate SyncLLM in both continuation and interaction settings. SyncLLM achieves synchrony modeling by integrating time information into LLMs so that they can run synchronously with the real-world clock... The model generates spoken dialogue with naturalistic turn-taking, overlaps, and backchannels.
